(I)--the son of Nimi, the last king of his line. भा. IX. २२. ४४-5.
(II)--a son of मेधातिथि, and founder of the kingdom क्षेमकम् in प्लक्षद्वीपम्. Br. II. १४. ३७ and ३९; वा. ३३. ३३; Vi.
(III)--a राक्षस who made Benares desolate. Br. III. ६७. २७.

(IV)--a son of निरामित्र; (Nimitta-वि। प्।), the last son of the Aila line (Paurava) (Kurus-वि। प्।); with him ends the source of the Brahma-क्षेत्र stock, the family honoured of gods and sages; the last dynasty consisting of २५ kings.
